title: Tata Sons IPO: RBI Forces Listing | Tata Stocks Jump 9%
description:
Tata group stocks jumped up to 9% after RBI sent a written mandate to Tata Sons reiterating its mandatory listing requirement.

Key facts:
• RBI classified Tata Sons as NBFC-Upper Layer in September 2022
• Listing deadline was September 2025 — now 14 months overdue
• Tata Sons tried to exit via CIC registration surrender; RBI rejected it September 2026
• RBI letter dated 16 Nov 2026 reiterates mandatory listing
• Tata Sons assets: ₹2.01 lakh crore (March 2026)
• Board meeting: 26 November 2026

Stock moves today:
• Tata Chemicals: +9% (₹669.05)
• Tata Investment Corporation: +7.51% (₹620)
• Tata Motors: +4%
• TCS, Tata Power, Voltas: +1–2%

Watch the Tata Sons board meeting on 26 Nov for the next major development.

Sources: BusinessToday, StartupFortune, KotakNeo (18 Nov 2026)
